column1: # Greek (el) catalog for the whole CFA4 interface (Qt GUI and egui). Same format as es.tsv:
# context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Greek video-editing vocabulary (χρονογραμμή, κομμάτι, κλιπ, ακολουθία, κάδος, κεφαλή
# αναπαραγωγής, δείκτης, μετάβαση, καρέ-κλειδί). No proprietary localisation resource, string table
# or product UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Commands are nouns of action
# ("Αποθήκευση ως…"), labels use sentence case, quotation marks are «», and product and format
# names (CFA4, Lumetri, ProRes, AAF, EDL…) keep their spelling. Decimal comma (0,5). A
# native-speaker review is welcome.
# Terms: clip = κλιπ, track = κομμάτι, sequence = ακολουθία, timeline = χρονογραμμή, bin = κάδος,
# playhead = κεφαλή αναπαραγωγής, marker = δείκτης, In/Out point = σημείο εισόδου/εξόδου, keyframe
# = καρέ-κλειδί, frame = καρέ, caption = υπότιτλος, preset = προρύθμιση, workspace = χώρος
# εργασίας, gain = απολαβή, opacity = αδιαφάνεια, render = απόδοση, ripple = με μετατόπιση,
# dissolve = διάλυση, wipe = σάρωση, transcript = απομαγνητοφώνηση, voice-over = αφήγηση, media =
# πολυμέσα, proxy = proxy, (Legacy) = (Παλαιό).
# Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (CFA4 contributors), except the section imported from craft-i18n at
# the end (MIT OR Apache-2.0); see el.tsv.attribution.
